purpose: Bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability that atomically creates or idempotently replays one self-scoped canonical Event, its NativeAddress, minimum expected-occurrence descriptor and immutable create-operation receipt without granting generic runtime DML.

routine.return_type: TABLE(event_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.current_binding: The capability returns canonical Event creation state or idempotent replay; it does not create Schedule, Recurrence, Actual or a Domain MaterialState.
state_history.chronology: A single statement_timestamp value is used for expectation descriptor and receipt in one authoritative transaction.
state_history.immutability_policy: Existing operation receipts are replay-only. Fingerprint mismatch rejects and cannot mutate the prior accepted operation.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: The routine is removed only by introducing migration downgrade, which fails closed while canonical Event expectation rows exist.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
runtime EXECUTE is granted while PUBLIC and dante_migrator EXECUTE are denied
runtime receives no generic INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE authority on Event persistence
UUIDv7 Event identity, NativeAddress, expectation descriptor and receipt are created atomically
same operation id/same intent replays and same operation id/different intent conflicts
